Definition: to press (intransitive), i.e. be narrow; figuratively, be in distress
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bind, be distressed, be in distress, be cramped, be narrow, be scant, be in straits, make narrow, cause distress, beseige; 1a) (Qal) to suffer distress
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
